# ICometRewards
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/compound-v3/ICometRewards.sol)

**Title:**
ICometRewards

Minimal interface for the Compound V3 (Comet) rewards contract


## Functions
### rewardConfig

Reward token address per Comet instance


```solidity
function rewardConfig(address comet) external view returns (RewardConfig memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`comet`|`address`|The Comet instance to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|

### claim

Claim rewards of token type from a comet instance to owner address


```solidity
function claim(address comet, address src, bool shouldAccrue) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`comet`|`address`|The protocol instance|
|`src`|`address`|The owner to claim for|
|`shouldAccrue`|`bool`|Whether or not to call accrue first|


### claimTo

Claim rewards of token type from a comet instance to a target address


```solidity
function claimTo(address comet, address src, address to, bool shouldAccrue) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`comet`|`address`|The protocol instance|
|`src`|`address`|The owner to claim for|
|`to`|`address`|The address to receive the rewards|
|`shouldAccrue`|`bool`|Whether or not to call accrue first|


## Structs
### RewardConfig
Reward token configuration for a Comet instance


```solidity
struct RewardConfig {
    address token;
    uint64 rescaleFactor;
    bool shouldUpscale;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The reward token address|
|`rescaleFactor`|`uint64`|The factor used to rescale accrued amounts to reward-token decimals|
|`shouldUpscale`|`bool`|Whether the rescale factor multiplies (true) or divides (false)|
